# UIButtonComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Clickable button of a script UI with a label, colors, an optional background and textures.

## Methods

### getLabel {#getlabel}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — text of the button

:::

### getColor {#getcolor}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — background color set by [`color(int)`](#color), as `0xRRGGBB`

:::

### getAlpha {#getalpha}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — opacity of the background and textures, 0 to 1

:::

### getTextColor {#gettextcolor}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — text color, as `0xRRGGBB`

:::

### isTextShadow {#istextshadow}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the text has a shadow

:::

### isBackground {#isbackground}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the background is drawn when the button has no texture

:::

### label {#label}

::: member

Changes the text of the button.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | new text |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::

### color {#color}

::: member

Sets the background color; by default it is the Scram theme color. Hovered buttons are a bit darker.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::

### alpha {#alpha}

::: member

Sets the opacity of the background and textures; the text keeps its own, see [`textAlpha(float)`](#textalpha).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque) |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::

### textColor {#textcolor}

::: member

Sets the text color; hovered text is a bit darker.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::

### textAlpha {#textalpha}

::: member

Sets the opacity of the text.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque); at least 0.1 is used |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::

### textShadow {#textshadow}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the text has a shadow |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::

### background {#background}

::: member

Shows or hides the background color; a button with a texture shows the texture instead.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `background` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the background is drawn |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::

### texture {#texture}

::: member

Draws a texture stretched over the button instead of the background.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `texture` | [`ScramClientTexture`](/scripting/client/scram/ScramClientTexture) | texture from `scram.texture(path)`, not null |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::

### textureHover {#texturehover}

::: member

Draws another texture while the mouse is over the button; needs [`texture(ScramClientTexture)`](#texture).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `texture` | [`ScramClientTexture`](/scripting/client/scram/ScramClientTexture) | texture from `scram.texture(path)`, not null |

**Returns** [`UIButtonComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIButtonComponent) — this button

:::
